headline: Silicon Labs Stock Pops on Report of Deal Talks With Texas Instruments
summary: Texas Instruments  is in advanced discussions about buying Silicon Laboratories, a maker of mixed-signal chips used in smart homes, industrial automation, and commercial applications, according to a report.  The Financial Times said that talks between the two companies were at an advanced stage and that a deal that values Silicon Laboratories at about $7 billion could happen within days.  Shares of Silicon Laboratories were up nearly 33% in late Tuesday trading after the report.
